sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown, contrasting with the colour of the postclypeus. Fontanelle small. Antennae 21-segmented in the female, 20-segmented in the male. Compound eyes large but not prominent, 0.13 mm from the lower margin of the head. Ocelli small, 0.13 mm long, 0.13 mm from the compound eye. Labrum pale yellow, with a pale transverse band. Postclypeus pale yellow, with a dark median line. Pronotum concolorous with the head, the anterior margin with two raised sharp projections, the posterior margin weakly concave. Posterior angles of the mesonotum and metanotum sharp, the posterior margin broadly concave. Costa and radius of the wings yellow; wing membrane hyaline, the remaining veins indistinct except near the suture. Body length with wings 22.50–24.00 mm in the male, 26.00–26.50 mm in the female; head length: male 2.40 mm, female 2.57–2.70 mm; head width: male 2.00 mm, female 2.15–2.20 mm; pronotal length: male 1.05 mm, female 1.28–1.45 mm; pronotal width: male 1.80 mm, female 2.15–2.30 mm; hind tibia length: male 2.25 mm, female 2.57–2.80 mm; forewing length: male 17.80 mm, female 21.20–22.30 mm; forewing width 5.08 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier: head reddish yellow, rectangular; the sides slightly rounded, not much narrowed anteriorly. Antennae 18-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 2 longer than segment 4. Labrum with trilobed hyaline points. Mandibles dark brown. Fontanelle a small inconspicuous point. Anterior margin of the pronotum with two long sharp spines; the sides rather straight, strongly narrowed posteriorly; posterior margin concave. Head length 4.60–5.10 mm; head width 2.50–2.60 mm; pronotal length 1.20–1.35 mm, width 1.90–2.08 mm; hind tibia length 2.00–2.50 mm; left mandible length 1.50 mm. Minor soldier given by measurements only: head length 2.50–2.85 mm; head width 1.20–1.50 mm; pronotal length 0.57–0.70 mm, width 0.80–1.00 mm; hind tibia length 1.40–1.60 mm; left mandible length 1.17–1.20 mm.
